name: jobs
description: Inspect, await and control existing work, regardless of the adapter or agent that performs it.

content.inline:
## Following work
Track each Job together with its purpose and hosting venue. A local proxy, a destination Job and a separate result waiter are different handles; keep their relationships explicit.

When the session promises an automatic completion notification, continue independent work instead of polling repeatedly. Otherwise inspect progress when it informs a decision, or wait with a budget suited to the task. Collect every delegated outcome before declaring the overall task complete.

On interruption, identify which Job needs input and respond there. On lost visibility, preserve the handle and recover observation; do not create duplicate work. On failure, inspect the cause and any side effects before deciding whether a fresh invocation is appropriate.

When sharing or delegating a Job reference, include its owner DID and hosting venue. Give collaborators the authority needed for their part of the workflow; loading a skill does not grant access.
